claims.text: ComfyUI published v0.31.0, v0.32.0, and v0.33.1 during W33.
The v0.32.0 release notes add Qwen-Image 3.0 Pro partner nodes, LTX 2.5 support/partner nodes, Grok-Imagine-Image-2.0 partner nodes, and MiniMax-H3 fixes.

limitations.text: ComfyUI support establishes W33 integration/adoption only; it does not establish the underlying models' first-release dates or capability claims.
